otj.text: Annie Flash is a retired outlaw who left the Freestriders after they robbed Akul and the Hellspurs, and Akul hunted them and nearly killed her nephew Tommy with his venom. Feeling responsible, she took Tommy into her care and quit the gang.

In Outlaws of Thunder Junction, Annie sees through Oko's illusion with her golden eye when he approaches her porch, and he offers her revenge by recruiting her for a heist against Akul. She refuses at first, but, unable to sleep after Oko's threat to her town, she digs up her buried thunder rifle and agrees to join, only as far as stopping Akul.

Oko announces the target is the vault Maag Taranau, which Annie thought a myth, and Annie sees through the illusions hiding Kaervek and Umezawa in their cells so that Eriette can free them. Later she tells Kellan how Akul hunted the Freestriders and injured her nephew, and why she cannot let him get the vault's power.

On the train job Oko orders Annie to blow up the bridge, and she returns to hold off the Sterling riders while the passengers jump. In Tarnation, Annie is captured with Oko, Kellan and Vraska, and Akul takes the sixth key to complete the full key.

Oko admits to Annie and Vraska that he leaked Tarnation's coordinates to Graywater to use the raid as a distraction, and that he brought Kellan because he knew he would get them caught. At the vault, Annie shoots Oko, purposely missing, before Ashiok, revealed as Jace Beleren, puts her to sleep.
